# Squishkit (vendored scenes)

The animated pond on the cover is **Squishkit**'s "Lily pond" scene (https://squishkit.vercel.app/site/scenes.html#pond),
copied from its published source (https://squishkit.vercel.app/src/) and trimmed for this site: only `scenes/` and the two
`core/` files it needs, with the scene and shader categories this site doesn't use, the 3D dioramas, fly-bys and cozy art set
unhooked (see the `// trimmed` lines in `scenes/scenes.js`, `scenes/shaders.js`, `scenes/index.js` and `scenes/art.js`).
Nothing else is changed.
